title: CI-gated SLO contract tests and rollout blockers for model upgrades
creator: Priya Patel
description: PRD: Define a set of automated SLO contract tests that run as part of PR/CICD for model and runtime upgrades. Tests should fail the PR if key operational contracts for latency (p50/p95/p99), availability, and error rate exceed defined thresholds for the target workload class. Establish rollout blockers and a lightweight remediation checklist so that model upgrades cannot be promoted to canary/production without passing the contract tests or an explicit exception.
acceptance_criteria: A CI job 'slo-contract-check' runs on every model/runtime upgrade PR and produces a pass/fail status visible on the PR
Contract checks include scoped p50/p95/p99 latency measurements for at least two representative synthetic workloads (chat-short, chat-long) and an embeddings batch job
PRs must validate that tail latency (p99) delta relative to baseline is within +10% for Hosted-Standard tier and +5% for Dedicated tier; failure marks PR blocked
Availability and 5xx error rate checks measured by synthetic canaries must be under defined error budgets (error rate < 0.1% over 30m window) or PR is blocked

If a contract check fails, the PR must include: (a) root-cause hypothesis, (b) mitigation plan (config rollback, kernel change, quantization tweak), (c) test-to-pass criteria; only then can a maintainer grant a temporary exception
Documentation: Confluence page with example test manifests, metrics thresholds, and how-to-run locally is published and linked from the CI job
Observability: failing test writes an incident-style runbook entry and attaches Grafana snapshot links to the PR

Plan: 2-week canary of blocking PRs for non-critical repos before wider enforcement. Maintain escape hatch: expiring exceptions trackable in the PR metadata.
